summary: Projects Production UX Closure. Bounded low-risk presentation-only refinement of the existing source-aware Action Index after Owner real Production Git sync: reduce duplicated Git/source text, separate historical projects in the default scan path, lower repetitive lifecycle and overflow-action noise, clarify source column semantics, and improve compact-row readability. Shared Shell/Navigation, schema, canonical data, lifecycle semantics, auth/security, updater mechanism, Courses and Topics are unchanged. OWNER explicitly requested publish; OWNER_DIRECT_RELEASE applies. OWNER_PREVIEW_RUNTIME remains POST_RELEASE_REQUIRED and OWNER_REAL_USE remains POST_PRODUCTION_REQUIRED. Release-gate reconciliation fixed the runtime version identity and updated only superseded literal contracts; product behavior is unchanged. Production remains Owner manual and this release request must not write Production data.
